adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that poll_feed.rb lines 27-33 iterate over all rss.items without any limit or pagination. The code does `rss.items.each do |i|` and calls TopicEmbed.import for each item. While TopicEmbed.import does check if an embed already exists (avoiding duplicate creation), the iteration itself processes every item in the feed on every hourly poll. For large feeds, this could cause significant work. However, this is more of a performance/scalability concern than a bug - the code will function correctly, just potentially inefficiently. The finding is grounded in actual diff code and represents a legitimate architectural concern for the new feature.
